suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out on a Friday and nothing broke over the weekend.
I'm thankful for the first sip of teh tarik when it's still too hot to drink properly.
I'm grateful for my dad calling just to ask about work, not because anything's wrong.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that taught me something instead of just nitpicking.
I'm grateful for the stillness right before Fajr, when even the cats outside go quiet.
I'm thankful for finding an old voice note from a friend who's since moved overseas.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that actually matches production for once.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a job that pays on time, every single month, no drama.
I'm grateful for the mamak uncle who still gives me extra kuah without asking.
I'm thankful for a stack trace that actually points to the real problem on the first try.
I'm grateful for the smell of rain hitting hot tarmac on the walk back from lunch.
I'm thankful for a nephew who still wants to show me his Roblox builds over video call.
I'm grateful for a long weekend announced with enough notice to actually plan a balik kampung trip.
I'm thankful for a teammate who owns up to breaking the build instead of going quiet.
I'm grateful for a khutbah that actually stuck with me past the car ride home.
